# docker_registry_login (Ephemeral Resource)

Validates registry credentials through the daemon (`POST /auth`, like `docker login`) and returns the identity token the registry issues, if any. It is ephemeral: the token and the response are never written to plan or state. Nothing is stored on the daemon or in a docker config file. Without `username`, the provider's matching `registry_auth` entry is used.

Ephemeral resources require Terraform 1.10 or later. Their values are never
stored in the plan or state, so they can only be referenced from ephemeral
contexts: write-only arguments, provider configuration, other ephemeral
resources, and ephemeral variables, locals and outputs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "registry_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

# Check credentials through the daemon (POST /auth) without storing anything.
ephemeral "docker_registry_login" "ghcr" {
  server_address = "ghcr.io"
  username       = "ci-bot"
  password       = var.registry_password
}

# The identity token, when the registry issues one, can replace the password
# in a later login. It is ephemeral, so pass it on only to ephemeral or
# write-only arguments.
locals {
  ghcr_status = ephemeral.docker_registry_login.ghcr.auth.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password or access token. Omitted: the password of the provider's `registry_auth` entry for `server_address`.
- `server_address` (String) Registry to log in to, e.g. `ghcr.io` or `localhost:5000`. Default `https://index.docker.io/v1/` (Docker Hub), as for `docker login`.
- `username` (String) User name. Omitted: the user name of the provider's `registry_auth` entry for `server_address`.

### Read-Only

- `auth` (Attributes) The POST /auth response as a nested object, field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `auth_json` (String, Sensitive) The exact Engine API POST /auth response as JSON.
- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of auth_json.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).

<a id="nestedatt--auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `auth`

Read-Only:

- `identity_token` (String, Sensitive) Upstream `IdentityToken`. Sensitive.
- `status` (String) Upstream `Status`.
